Questions players keep asking

Why does the silhouette sometimes look like two different characters?

OnePiecedle pulls from both pre- and post-timeskip designs depending on the daily seed. Franky's two designs are radically different. Pre-timeskip has the exaggerated forearms, the blue pompadour, and the open Hawaiian shirt. Post-timeskip is bulkier, shaved head, metal plating visible on the shoulders. The game doesn't tell you which era it's using, so if you're guessing blind, cover both. The hair is the tell—if it's blue and vertical, it's pre-timeskip. If it's gone, it's post.

What's the fastest solve strategy for character mode?

Start with crew affiliation, then devil fruit status, then bounty range. That three-step filter solves about 80% of characters in under five guesses. For the remaining 20%—usually Marines, Revolutionaries, or unaffiliated characters—switch to first appearance arc and haki type. Don't guess on silhouette until you've got at least two attribute confirmations. The penalty for wrong silhouette guesses is steep and the point differential between a four-guess solve and a seven-guess solve is what separates the daily leaderboard from the also-rans.
